decision_scope: Retain a narrow Bayesian/point sharp-RD reference and defer production integration.

source.anchor: complete Apache2.0 license, conditions and notices

primary_evidence.anchor: Twelve original blobs verified against pinned tree

rationale: Useful quasi-experimental model interface; local causal interpretation still requires design and target restrictions.
Finite prediction separation and dimension conversion can silently alter target or uncertainty without an explicit wrapper.
No executed upstream adapter oracle or resolved environment currently establishes qualified integration.

alternatives.reason: Target, failure and uncertainty boundaries need wrapper validation.
Preserve upstream models and write a small explicit boundary layer.
Transfers sampler/model/design maintenance without demonstrated benefit.
Use pinned source to inform proposal and reproducible design examples now.
No evidence of fundamental infeasibility or uselessness; qualification remains scoped.
Documented local-polynomial and bias-corrected intervals answer a distinct uncertainty question.

owner_obligations.scientific: Own local estimand, continuity and exclusion of simultaneous policy changes.
owner_obligations.integration: Own frozen data/design, conversion, failure semantics and separate operations by design.
owner_obligations.runtime: Own resolved environment, complete notices, sampler diagnostics and change control.
owner_obligations.evaluation: Own public/generated benchmark mechanisms, dependence units and predeclared evaluation.

costs_to_measure: Conversion maintenance and public prototype comparison
revisit_trigger: A pinned reproducible environment plus implemented conversion contract and executed upstream-oracle results; assess each causal design separately.
limitations: Static upstream source inspection and exact project arithmetic only; no CausalPy installation, sampling or engine execution.
Resolved dependencies, complete third-party rights and actual sampler behavior remain unqualified.
Identification requires an explicit design; no general RD coverage, bank value or implemented adapter is claimed.
Rendered visual acceptance awaits a fresh image allowance; Q1 and Q5 remain open.
